claimPolicy: All numeric appearance values are authored assumptions. Verified sources support principles only. Images are conceptual references, not measured shader output, surveyed geography, calibrated camera renders or device results.

units.darkening: percent linear RGB / luminance reduction relative to baseColourHex
units.screen: CSS px at 390x844; second review at 320x693
units.sheen: effective maximum reflected-sky blend weight at grazing view 0..1, not metallic or raw specular

compatibility.referenceSchema: rain-v1/rain-values.json schemaVersion1.0; preserves states[].surfaceValues[] darkeningPercent, linearBaseMultiplier, roughness, sheenStrength
compatibility.ownership: Replace one material policy; never multiply additional weather/ground darkening. Inherit weather lighting/fog once. Snow masks suppress water/ice/ground sheen where opaque.
compatibility.palettePrecedence: Mapped bathymetry/shoreline and live sky win; authored defaults only when their input is unavailable and an explicit demo state is selected.
compatibility.productionStatus: Renderer-neutral proposal data, not installed or validated against a production loader. New lake fields require adapter support.

materialFormula.base: Cbase_linear = decodeSRGB(baseColourHex); Cdark_linear = Cbase_linear * linearBaseMultiplier; resultHex = encodeSRGB(Cdark_linear), rounded to nearest 8-bit channel.
materialFormula.sheen: Cfinal_linear=(1-k)*Cshaded_linear+k*Csky_reflected_linear; water k=(0.12+(0.55-0.12)*(1-abs(dot(N,V)))^5)*exposureMask*aerialScale. Use sky evaluated in reflected direction, not a uniform colour.
materialFormula.iceAndSlush: k=sheenStrength*(1-abs(dot(N,V)))^3*exposureMask*aerialScale. Snow same proxy with its own small sheen.
materialFormula.roughness: Apply to reflection lobe/normal filtering; do not also add an uncalibrated physical specular pass. Proxy OR calibrated BRDF, not both.
materialFormula.colourDelta: linearLuminanceChangePercent compares decoded resultHex to comparisonColourHex using Y=.2126R+.7152G+.0722B. Dirty/slush hue changes are authored replacements, not achievable by a single grey multiplier.
materialFormula.coverage: All ice/snow/branch percentages describe opaque eligible areas. No translucent white overlay. One stable world-space mask; no new random placement each frame.

water.wavePolicy: Amplitude is half peak-to-trough height. Profiles are look fixtures, not wave forecasts. Actual wind direction, duration, fetch, depth and observed waves override. Wind0 fixture has no leftover swell; live state can retain swell history.

shoreline.application: Water-side band only. Smoothstep from shore inward: shade multiplier=0.88+0.12*smoothstep(0,0.60,distanceToShore). Independent shore geometry remains fixed. Shallow-colour weight=1-smoothstep(0,shallowBlendWidthM,distanceToShore). No extra land darkening.
shoreline.edge: Separate 0.40m material transition into existing wet bank, clipped to mapped terrain intersection. No black border, alpha water overlay or shoreline relocation.

reflection.policy: These stylized blend coefficients are not measured Fresnel. No white brightness floor at night. Reuse sky environment; no planar mirrors, SSR, extra captures or per-ripple lights.

haze.policy: One shared weather haze term. Longer sight lines get more haze naturally; no separate lake fog multiplier. Live fog overrides fixture.

lod.farPolicy: Fade subpixel normals, retain mean roughness and broad reflected sky. Never enlarge world-space wavelengths to force visibility. Wind0 means no wave oscillation.

ice.policy: Coverage fixtures depict Sloan city lake only. Never apply fully_frozen fixture to all Lake Michigan from air temperature. Freeze disables waves only inside ice mask; open water remains animated. No crack/photo texture. Snow coverage denominator is ice area, not full lake area.

branchSnow.eligibleSurface: Upward-facing structural branch/crown tops; normal dot up >=0.35. Denominator is this eligible area, not whole tree silhouette.
branchSnow.policy: Fresh and day2 are seeded comparison fixtures. Clock age alone never sheds snow. Wind exposure, melt, canopy type and new snowfall update area mask. Merge structural snow strips at range; no leaf/needle/twig geometry.

oldSnow.persistence: When supplied snow depth outside the 0.80m curb zone falls below0.01m, retain only supplied remaining bank/slush inside eligible curb zone until reservoir is zero. Distance is maximum support strip, not duration. Do not invent snow along every curb.
oldSnow.policy: Traffic/plow contamination affects pile base, not clean lawn uniformly. Snow depth, thaw/solar exposure and reservoir govern melt; days only select artwork fixtures. Existing clear corridors, crossings and ramps clip banks and slush.

water: Wind speed and direction history for last3hours
Fetch/depth/shore geometry or explicit look fixture; observed waves if available
ice: Observed or supplied ice concentration/geometry and lake surface water temperature
Air temperature time series and cumulative freezing degree-hours (sum(max(0,-TairC)*hours)) as context
Wind/mixing, bathymetry and multi-day water thermal history; no universal cold-hour threshold
branchSnow: Snowfall water equivalent and event end time
Retained crown snow load and canopy type
Wind exposure/gust history, positive-degree-hours, solar exposure and new snowfall
oldSnow: Days since snowfall, cumulative positive-degree-hours and rain-on-snow
Explicit clearing/plowing timestamps, retained displaced-bank volume and curb drainage
weatherHistory.missingHistory: Unknown stays unknown. Preserve last supplied state if valid; otherwise do not infer ice/banks/snow from season or present weather code. Explicit demo fixtures are labelled.

lowCost: Existing sky sampling and world-space broad masks
mediumCost: Two analytic world-stable wave components in shared water shader
Branch/crown caps batched as opaque geometry
Simple existing bank ridge geometry with basal colour band
highCost: Data ingestion for observed ice geometry and lake thermal state
Mapped bathymetry/fetch and weather-driven wave simulation
Snow retention/melt and displaced-volume history system
representation.budgetPolicy: All additions share existing buckets, never independent additive allocations. No new timing claims. Measure combined rain-v1 plus lake/winter on device before adoption.
degradeOrder: Subpixel wave normals and optional near glint modulation
Distant branch strips merged into5/3cap LOD
Keep broad water/ice/snow area and route geometry

bankLimits.policy: Share inherited near geometry budget; retained volume/clear-corridor input wins.

sources.supports: Smaller sheltered lakes have less fetch and generally smaller waves. Numerical wave profiles in this pack are authored.
NOAA ice studies use thermal structure, surface water temperature and regional weather; ice cover is observed/modeled, not inferred from one current air temperature.
Linear-light darkening, sheen convention, exact inherited snow palette and budgets.
Cream/forest poster and exact hex + linear change + sheen/roughness swatch format.
